games.name: Robong: Megabonk [EVOLVE] [CO-OP]
games.desc:
🧟 ROBONG SURVIVORS — co-op horde survival. Hundreds of zombies, ghosts and goblins at once. Your weapons fire on their own; you choose what they become.

⚔️ SEASON 3 IS LIVE

▸ THE RUN
Every level-up is a choice. Max a weapon, pair it with the right perk, and it EVOLVES.
Kill the Guardian and a portal opens: leave and bank your gems (+60%), or stay for the Chaos and risk the whole run.

▸ 5 MAPS
Castle → City → Desert → Arena → Frozen. Clear one to unlock the next. Each ends in a boss.

▸ WHAT YOU KEEP
10 classes with a "Q" ability · pets to hatch, level and merge · skill tree · clans with quests and research · seasonal leaderboards and titles.

▸ 1-4 PLAYER CO-OP
Revive your team, vote at the portal, clear maps together.

🔄 UPDATED EVERY WEEK — report bugs on Discord.
🎁 CODES on our Discord · 👍 LIKE + JOIN THE GROUP for rewards.
